title: 중소기업은행법제54조제6항시행에관한규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:20653:20080229:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment, etc. of the Financial Services Commission <Presidential Decree No. 20653, February 29, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. Provided, however, that provisions amending Presidential Decrees promulgated before the enforcement of this Decree whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived, among Presidential Decrees amended under Article 2 of these Addenda, shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (37) Omitted.
(38) Part of the Regulations on the Enforcement of Article 54 (6) of the Industrial Bank of Korea Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2 (1), "Minister of Finance" in the nominative shall be replaced with "Financial Services Commission" in the nominative, and "to the Minister of Finance" shall be replaced with "to the Financial Services Commission"; in paragraph (2) of the same Article, "Minister of Finance" shall be replaced with "Financial Services Commission".
In Article 3 (2), "to the Minister of Finance" shall be replaced with "to the Financial Services Commission".
In Article 7, "Minister of Finance" shall be replaced with "Financial Services Commission".
In Article 8, "Minister of Finance" shall be replaced with "Financial Services Commission".
In Article 9, "Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance" shall be replaced with "Ordinance of the Prime Minister".
(39) through (49) Omitted.
